name: Cloudflare Tunnel
description: Reach COGNIX[WS] from any network at your own address through a Cloudflare Tunnel. Nothing to install on the phone; every device still pairs.

settings.label: Tunnel token
settings.description: From Cloudflare: Zero Trust → Networks → Tunnels → your tunnel → Install connector. Stored protected on this computer.

settings.label: Public address
settings.description: The public hostname you added to the tunnel, like pc.example.com.

settings.label: Local port
settings.description: In Cloudflare, set the public hostname's service to http://localhost and this port.
